sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-05-r17-quick/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 34 (#33) and Internal Quality Checks row 34 (#33, annotation: 'we usually combine the multiple verifiers in one flow')
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-05-r17-quick/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow, checks 26/28/33)
evidence: Read all 55 criterion descriptions (3 gate, 43 Functional, 6 Polish, 3 Visual). None enumerates several requirements and then waives most of them. Every carve-out is either (a) an explicit tolerance that is part of the single bar, e.g. cw_mouse_selection 'One character of pointer imprecision at either end of the drag is not a failure', triple click 'with or without its line break'; cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo / cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' (consistent with 'characters inside the string unchanged'); cw_last_good_recovery 'The restored picture may be static'; cw_find_forward_backward_wrap 'the first occurrence may already be current'; or (b) an exclusion of an observable that is genuinely graded by a named sibling: cw_basic_run_output stale first-run preview -> cw_run_starts_fresh_document; cw_output_before_failure_kept end reason -> cw_error_message_and_line/cw_time_limit_recovery/cw_stop_cancels_pending_work; cw_time_limit_recovery and cw_stop_cancels_pending_work earlier picture -> cw_last_good_recovery; cw_last_good_recovery later valid Run -> cw_time_limit_recovery final valid Run; cw_history_restore_adds_revision repeat restore -> cw_restore_request_repeat_safe; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft conflict message -> cw_stale_save_refused; cw_multi_caret_delete / cw_same_line_carets both modifiers -> cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic; polish 'Run output' and 'control the app does not have' -> functional criteria. I verified each 'scored elsewhere' target exists, so no exclusion silently drops a requirement. Alternatives are one bar with stated equivalents, not two targets: cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus 'unless the ordinary Tab key does it, the app must show on screen which keys do' (necessary because cw_block_indent_undo makes Tab indent); cw_replace_all_atomic disabled Redo 'is enough'; cw_history_restore_adds_revision 'either refused or added on top'; cw_preview_isolation public-https repeat is conditional on availability, with the localhost no-cors fetch always required. Each 'Fails if' list matches its positive bar in the cases checked, and functional/polish prompt.md line 'A criterion is a conjunction: every step it lists must hold' (functional prompt.md:15, polish prompt.md:14) resolves any fail-list that is narrower than the stated musts toward the stricter single bar. Visual likert anchors are monotone single scales. Per SKILL.md and the internal annotation, bundling several conjunctive legs into one flow criterion is not a row-33 defect; whether such bundles should be split for independent credit is row 26/28 scope per REVIEW_POLICY, not this row. Broken-app probe: an app that discards A's unsaved draft by reverting to the pre-edit saved revision (not B's) on a newer-revision notice would escape cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft's literal fail list ('if A's draft is replaced by B's saved source') but fails the stated must 'A's editor must still hold exactly A's unsaved draft' under the conjunction rule, so the bar is not two targets. Conforming-alternative probe: an editor whose Tab indents and whose exit key is shown on screen passes both cw_block_indent_undo and cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus; no criterion waives a requirement another demands. Notes (not defects): (1) cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (functional judge.toml:407) fail list names only replacement by B's source while the must says 'still hold exactly A's unsaved draft'; adding 'emptied, reverted or otherwise changed' to the fail list would remove any reading gap. (2) cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget (line 281) says 'the preview must keep working' without a matching fail clause; cw_html_preview (line 227) requires 'rendered in the preview as a heading' but its fail list only names escaped source text. Both are covered by the conjunction rule. This row is a static text review; no runtime evidence is needed for it, and the raw-evidence index (golden and earlier-candidate hosted runs) was not relied on.
